reason: The citation is flawless and I could not dent it either, so the rejection is on fit, which is where the refutation put it and where I agree. September's theme is Justice and Service and the blurb is what is owed; this sentence is the canonical statement that the vocabulary of obligation is an embarrassment, and in the novel it is the hinge on which Frederic Henry turns toward desertion. Rule 3 asks that the line help at six in the morning on the month's theme and puts famous and bleak out, and on a card about the debt to other people this reads as a refusal of the debt. There is a second, independent ground: rule 8 allows one Hemingway in the month, and the verified carry-in 03-cfl-04 from The Sun Also Rises is already marked fitMonth 9 and has prior claim on the slot. Having failed once on the refutation and again here, the line is out for September. Confidence is medium because fit is a judgement and the citation would need no work if a later month wanted it.
